newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco to guarantee investments worth $655.7 mln.
newsitem.headline: Morocco to guarantee investments worth $655.7 mln.

text.p: Morocco's state-owned Caisse Centrale de Garantie (CCG) said on Friday it would guarantee jointly with commercial banks investments worth 6.3 billion dirhams ($655.7 million) under a five-year plan.
"Half that amount will be covered by Moroccan commercial banks starting this year," CCG director Larbi Bellaha told a news conference.
The fund which dates back to 1949 has been refreshing its legislation to reinforce its support to small and medium sized firms but excludes the high sea fisheries from its plans, Bellaha said.
"Outstanding payments in the sector of high sea fisheries stand at 1.0 billion dirhams, it suffers from overexploitation so we do not plan investments during that period," he added.

Bellaha said the CCG is looking to create a 500 million dirhams fund to upgrade Moroccan firms ahead of the setting up of a free trade zone with Europe by the year 2010. It will also be financed by the European Investment Bank and the firms themselves.
